description:
🚀 Join Our NASA Space Apps Challenge Team! 🌌
We’re looking for creative and motivated people who love space, technology, and problem-solving! 🌍
💻 We especially need a Web Developer to help build our website. You don’t need to be an expert—just be willing to learn, collaborate, and have fun!
Let’s learn, create, and tackle the challenge together! 🚀💙
